summary: Confirmed PARTIAL. 60633eff3 implemented the headline proposal. A persisted, non-secret per-environment session hint (savedSessionHints.ts) lets a direct connect skip the pre-socket GET /api/auth/session whenever the remembered bearer session is at least 1h from expiry and not due for renewal. The connect goes straight to ws-token plus socket and re-asks the session in the background after register. The server answers a rejected bearer on ws-token with 401, which is terminal on the client (store-unavailable is 503, non-terminal), so the skip is safe. This removes one HTTP RTT from the critical path on hinted connects. Not delivered: the proposal's 'read the bearer once per attempt' (kept deliberately) and the expected −1-2 keychain reads. On the hinted path the background check adds a third SecureStore read, so total reads rose by one, off the critical path. Small gaps the auditor missed: in-session renewals (keepRenewed) never refresh the hint; AppAccessGate re-reads the bearer on every registry change, including each socket open; and a narrow window in addSavedEnvironment can re-record the replaced credential's hint after forgetSessionHint. All are low value. Web/desktop keep the same precheck, but that is outside this mobile finding.

evidence.note: usableSavedSessionHint: bearer-session-token only, at least 1h to expiry, and !shouldRenewSavedSession. This is the proposal's skip condition.
createSavedSessionHints(mobileKV) is injected into the mobile driver, so the hint is live in production.
Keychain bearer read and hint KV read run in parallel.
Hinted path: no pre-socket session GET. The role is patched from the hint.
renew() with the hinted session is a no-op (savedSessionRenewal.ts:194-197). The hint is recorded only after a fresh node answer and only when not cancelled.

Background session check after register: rejection goes to rejectCredential; success re-records the hint, patches the role and re-arms keepRenewed. It reads the bearer from SecureStore again (:540-541), so the hinted path makes 3 keychain reads (396, resolver 345, 541) where the old non-due path made 2.
The URL resolver re-reads the bearer on every attempt, deliberately (superseded-bearer invariant also stated at :302-305). The 'read once per attempt' part of the proposal is not implemented.
There is no in-memory caching: every readBearerToken is a SecureStore.getItemAsync call.
The ws-token route authenticates the bearer and maps AuthError through respondToAuthError (http.ts:17-30) to error.status.
A rejected session credential maps to 401 (terminal on the client). An unavailable session store maps to 503 (non-terminal, retried). This confirms the hinted skip relies on a real terminal 401.
isSavedEnvironmentCredentialRejection is 401 only. It is wired as isTerminalUrlError/onTerminalUrlError at environmentDriver.ts:359-360.

keepRenewed rotates the bearer in-session and re-arms from renewed.session, but has no hook to refresh the persisted hint. After an in-session renewal the hint still describes the old, due session, so the next cold connect pays the precheck once (errs toward checking; not unsafe).

addSavedEnvironment forgets the hint before two awaited storage writes (:106-110). The old pending attempt is only cancelled and the old connection removed at :122-123. An old attempt's fresh-check record (environmentDriver.ts:475-476, guarded only by !isCancelled()) or an old hinted connection's background check (:551-557, guarded by isCurrent()) resolving in that window re-records the replaced credential's session, and connect at :124 can start from it. The effect is a transiently stale role until the background check; the new bearer is fresh, so there is no renewal or auth hole.

The launch gate reads the bearer from SecureStore and re-evaluates on every registryStore change. markConnected on each socket open (environmentDriver.ts:285 -> packages/client-runtime/src/connection/catalog.ts:134-143) therefore triggers one more keychain read per connect and reconnect.

A foreground resume calls connection.reconnect() (transport URL resolver only), so a live connection's foreground reconnect never paid the session precheck. The finding's 'per foreground reconnect' applies only to fresh connectSavedEnvironment runs (cold start, retry after a failed connect, manual reconnect).

Tests cover the hinted skip with background check, forget, a cancelled attempt not recording, renewal-due fallthrough, fresh-check recording, background rejection, and ws-token rejection forgetting the hint. None cover keepRenewed refreshing the hint or the addSavedEnvironment forget/cancel window.
Out of scope for this mobile finding: web/desktop still ask the session before every saved-environment socket. The hint store lives in apps/mobile, not client-runtime, so they cannot reuse it.

remaining: 1) The proposal's 'read the bearer once per attempt and hand it to the first URL resolution' is not implemented, by design. Hinted connects read the bearer at environmentDriver.ts:396 and again at :345 on the critical path, plus a third read at :541 for the background check. The finding's −1-2 keychain reads were not delivered: the hinted path makes one more read than before, off the critical path. 2) keepRenewed (savedSessionRenewal.ts:240-258) never refreshes the hint after an in-session rotation, so the next cold connect pays one avoidable precheck RTT. 3) AppAccessGate.tsx:106 re-reads the bearer on every registry change, including markConnected on each socket open. 4) There is a narrow window in environmentActions.ts:95 (forget) vs :122-123 (cancel/remove) where the replaced credential's hint can be re-recorded and used by the re-pair connect at :124, giving a transiently stale role. By design and not a gap: the first connect after the session turns 1 day old still runs the full sequential check+rotate+write+read+activation path before ws-token, as the proposal required.
fixDefects: Minor and low-severity. In addSavedEnvironment (apps/mobile/src/connection/environmentActions.ts), forgetSessionHint at :95 runs before the awaited persistRecord/writeBearerToken and before cancelPendingSavedEnvironmentConnection/remove at :122-123. During that window an old in-flight attempt is not yet cancelled (environmentDriver.ts:475 checks only !isCancelled()), and an old hinted connection is still current (:552 isCurrent()). Either can call sessionHints.record for the replaced credential, which undoes the forget that the comment at environmentDriver.ts:473-474 says must not be undone. The re-pair connect at :124 can then skip its pre-socket check and show the old session's role until the background check corrects it within one RTT. This is not an auth hole: the new bearer is freshly issued, the ws-token 401 stays terminal, and the server enforces the role. No other defects found. The skip condition, the terminal 401 (confirmed: ServerAuth.ts toCredentialRejection status 401; store-unavailable 503 is non-terminal), serialized hint writes, and non-secret persistence are all sound.
implementationSketch:
Safe, no-decision parts (each S, low risk):
(a) Refresh the hint after in-session renewal. In packages/client-runtime/src/connection/savedSessionRenewal.ts, add an optional `onSession?: (session: AuthSessionState) => void` to the keepRenewed request. In renewDue, call it with answer.session when the answer is authenticated, and with renewed.session after a successful rotation (renewed.bearerToken !== bearerToken). In apps/mobile/src/connection/environmentDriver.ts, pass `onSession: (s) => { if (isCurrent()) sessionHints?.record(record.environmentId, s); }` at both keepRenewed call sites (:530, :562). Tests: savedSessionRenewal.test.ts asserts onSession receives the activated session after rotation. environmentDriver.test.ts uses fake timers to drive a keepRenewed rotation, then asserts sessionHints.read returns the new session and a second connectSavedEnvironment registers before fetchRemoteSessionState is called.
(b) Close the forget/cancel window. In environmentActions.ts addSavedEnvironment, call registry.driver.forgetSessionHint(environmentId) again after `await registry.driver.supervisor.remove(...)` (:123) and before connect(record) (:124). Keep the early call. Test: an environmentActions test with a fake driver whose pending attempt resolves (and records) during persistRecord. Assert the subsequent connect asks the session before the socket and that the stored hint carries the new session's role.
(c) Stop the gate re-reading the keychain on each socket open. In AppAccessGate.tsx:106, subscribe with a key check: remember the sorted environmentId list and call evaluate() only when it changes (lastConnectedAt-only updates are ignored). Test: a gate/unit test that markConnected does not call catalog.readBearerToken again.
Needs decision (optional, low value, about 1-5 ms per SecureStore read): (d) read the bearer once per attempt. Option 1: hand the bearer read at environmentDriver.ts:396 to the first resolver invocation (a one-shot `firstBearer` consumed by the URL provider) only when renew() kept that bearer and no rotation is in flight for the environment. Option 2: a write-through in-memory bearer cache in the mobile catalog, which is coherent on mobile because there is a single JS runtime and every write goes through catalog.writeBearerToken/removeBearerToken. rotateAndStore's durable read-back (savedSessionRenewal.ts:179) must bypass it. Either option conflicts with the documented 'never present a remembered bearer' invariant (environmentDriver.ts:302-305, :338-341) and changes locked-keychain behaviour (SavedEnvironmentBearerUnavailableError), so get sign-off first. Tests: extend 'never presents a bearer a renewal superseded' (environmentDriver.test.ts:598) to cover the handed-over bearer.
decisionReason: This applies only to the leftover 'read the bearer once per attempt' item (d). Reusing a bearer read earlier, or caching it in memory, changes auth semantics around superseded-bearer presentation (the node revokes the pairing on a superseded bearer after grace) and changes locked-keychain behaviour. The code explicitly chose to re-read on every use. Items (a)-(c) are safe, non-secret, conservative changes and need no decision.
correction: The auditor's PARTIAL classification and evidence hold. I traced the status mapping they left open: a rejected credential gives 401 (terminal) and a store-unavailable gives 503 (non-terminal). They missed four things: (1) the hinted path adds a third keychain read (background check at environmentDriver.ts:541), so keychain reads did not drop at all — they rose by one, off the critical path; (2) keepRenewed rotations don't refresh the hint; (3) AppAccessGate re-reads the bearer on every markConnected, not only at launch; (4) a narrow forget-before-cancel window in environmentActions.ts:95 vs :122. Also, the finding's 'per foreground reconnect' was overstated: a live connection's resume reconnect goes through the transport resolver only and never hit the precheck.
